title: Steins;Gate: Oukoubakko no Poriomania
justification: AniList 10863 (OVA, 1 episode from 2012-02-22) is AniDB 7729's special S1 Oukoubakko no Poriomania (Egoistic Poriomania), aired 2012-02-22. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 9253, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 7729, and the special's title matches AniList's romaji, English and native titles. The parent's row places S1 on TVDB 0x1 Egoistic Poriomania (2012-02-22) and on TMDB 42509 S0E1 Egoistic Poriomania (2012-02-22).
